ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme low-intensity (black) dominance across the primary surface with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal terminals and median notch apex.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black contiguous pigmentation across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white geometric blobs (rosettes) are localized at the left and right fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an acute interior angle (approx. 45-50 degrees) dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations characterized by sharp, irregular peaks and valleys along the entire continuous linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward the pointed terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal margins of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring/barnacle encrustations on the terminal tips of both lobes; lower central portion of the fluke surface is occluded by water turbulence.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white-water splash/wake occluding the mid-ventral and lower-trailing regions near the fluke base.
